title: Figure 7: CNT Forest - Vertically Aligned Carbon Nanotubes (Lockheed Martin)
description: Grayscale electron microscope image of a dense, vertically aligned carbon nanotube forest grown on a substrate, with an inset at lower left showing a close-up of an individual twisted nanotube strand. The caption reads 'CNT forests grown in Lockheed Martin's laboratories can be tailored for specific sizes, lengths, and densities.'
